answer: One concrete defense is to anchor each agent identity to a costly, verifiable stake that stays locked while it participates, like an anchor holding a ship in place. A brand-new identity begins as a lone island with no reputation and tiny transaction limits, and trust only grows as real work accrues. A zephyr of free fake accounts then costs real capital to spawn, and misbehavior forfeits the stake, so flooding the economy with sybils stops paying.
